Greene Slams Trump Over Fuel Prices
On Saturday, in a post on
, Greene said, "Insane!! Diesel in Central Florida is almost $7 dollars!! This is all Trump’s fault! We did not vote for this."
She added, "We shouldn’t pay taxes to a government that ruins our lives."
In a video shared alongside the post, Greene said diesel was "almost $7" per gallon while regular gasoline was $4.79.
"Americans did not vote for this. They cannot afford it. It is going to crush our economy and it’s only just getting started," she said.
She also criticized Trump’s handling of the conflict with Iran, saying, "Trump is destroying this country by fighting Iran and there’s no end in sight."
The former Congresswoman said the current prices were inconsistent with what voters were promised. "We voted for what, gas under $2? That that’s what we were promised."
Greene concluded, "Look, this is I cannot believe we’re paying taxes to a government that is doing this to us, especially when we voted for what, gas under $2?"
The national average diesel price climbed to $6.4866 per gallon on Saturday, according to data from the American Automobile Association (AAA).
